business_problem: According to the Glauco Volpe, head of cloud services and infrastructure at Infosys, one of the project's goals is the smart use of the knowledge produced and stored within the company.
solution_summary: Infosys, one of the global leaders in consulting and next-generation digital services, will use an artificial-intelligence (AI)-based solution to provide first-level support to its clients. Powered by AWS cloud and developed by the AWS business partner MadeinWeb , the application should increase service quality and efficiency. The solution proposed by MadeinWeb, in collaboration with AWS, was built based on a robust architecture. The process began by creating a secure repository in the Amazon Simple Storage Service ( Amazon S3 ), providing fast, secure, and cost-effective access to thousands of documents related to Infosys calls, knowledge bases, and technical standards. Native integration with Amazon S3 objects made it easy to implement the Amazon OpenSearch Service , creating a fully vectorized database.

solution_components.name: Amazon S3
solution_components.role: Stores source data, documents, or generated artifacts used by the customer and agent support workflows.

solution_components.name: Amazon OpenSearch Service
solution_components.role: Indexes content and powers search or analytics for the customer and agent support workflows.

solution_components.name: Amazon Bedrock
solution_components.role: Runs the foundation model layer for the customer and agent support workflows.

solution_components.name: Amazon API Gateway
solution_components.role: Exposes APIs that front the customer and agent support workflows.

solution_components.name: AWS Lambda
solution_components.role: Executes serverless processing and workflow glue for the customer and agent support workflows.
